rationale: The assistant matched the expected first step exactly, asking whether the display was blank or lit and whether it would start or heat, then correctly split the lit-display-won't-start symptom into door interlock or child lock without asserting a cause. Once the customer reported the 'L' symbol it correctly identified the control lock, gave the hold-Stop instruction with appropriate hedging ('very likely', '3-5 seconds'), and the fix matched the hidden truth. Safety guidance was consistent (unplug, never remove casing) and no parts or escalation were suggested. Minor deduction on question quality because the second turn bundled door-hook inspection with the lock check rather than asking about the display symbol first.
